blocks.text: The radius of a star can be calculated using Wien's displacement law and the Stefan-Boltzmann law. For this purpose, the surface temperature T of a star is first determined using Wien's displacement law. The Luminosity of a star can be calculated using the radiant flux intensity and then Stefan-Boltzmann law is used to determine the radius of star.
